- Install the latest version of SMAPI

If you’re using Portraiture or are an [b][u][color=#00ff00]Android[/color][/u] [/b]user, follow these steps:
- Ensure your Android game version supports mods. You can check this by verifying that SMAPI is successfully installed.
- Create a new folder (if it doesn’t exist already) and name it “[size=3][i]Igor’s Anime Portraits[/i][/size]”.
- Place this folder in the following path: \Mods\Portraiture\Portraits. If done correctly, the portrait file of "[u][size=4][b]Emily[/b][/size][/u]" for [u]example[/u] should be located at:\Mods\Portraiture\Portraits\[size=3]Igor’s Anime Portraits[/size]\Emily.png.[/font]
